gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules print sale of assets inside receipts: General Fund 'Local' 1,073,851 (p10) = Local 1,057,994 + Sale of assets 15,857 (p7 combining General Fund statement), and Road Fund 'Local' 112,276 (p12) = Local 36,082 + Sale of assets 76,194 (p5), both in detail[] as revenue. The governmental funds statement (p5-6) prints Sale of assets 15,857 + 76,194 = 92,051 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), outside TOTAL RECEIPTS 10,897,129 (JSON other_financing 92,051). 10,989,180 - 92,051 = 10,897,129. Both printed classifications; no line missing or duplicated.
